title: Hardship Extensions on Retail Installment Contracts: Eligibility and the Signed Agreement
content:
**1. Status.** On Retail Installment Contracts, an extension is granted only on a contract whose status is active. A contract with a repossession case in pre-repo review, assigned or recovered status is not eligible for an extension.

**2. Signed agreement.** An extension is applied only under an extension agreement of request type extension that the borrower has signed. The extension agreement must be signed no later than the tier's signature period in days after the request was created. The signature period is counted in calendar days from the date part of the request's creation time, and a signature on the last day of the period is in time; an unsigned request lapses and a new request is needed.

**3. Account condition.** The contract must have at least the tier's minimum installments paid for an extension and be at least the tier's minimum and no more than its maximum days past due for an extension on the effective date.

**4. Deferral limits.** The clause "One extension defers at most the tier's maximum installments per request, the installments deferred in the rolling 12 months including this one may not exceed the tier's maximum per 12 months, and over the contract's life including this one may not exceed the tier's maximum per life" is **no longer in force**; it is superseded by the current basis for the installments a hardship extension agreement defers.

**5. Spacing.** A new extension may take effect only when its effective date is at least the tier's minimum days since the last extension after the effective date of the previous extension. That interval is counted in calendar days from the previous extension's effective date, and an effective date exactly on the boundary qualifies.

**6. Effect.** The extension moves the next due date and the final installment date later by the number of deferred months on the same due day; the scheduled payment does not change and simple interest keeps accruing on the principal during the deferral.

**7. Fee.** The clause "The extension fee is the tier's extension fee and is assessed on the effective date, except that where the tier waives the first extension fee and the contract has no earlier extension, the fee is waived" is **no longer in force**; it is superseded by the current basis for the hardship extension fee.

## Boundaries (hypothetical dates)

| Test | Period | Last day in time / first qualifying day | One day outside |
|---|---|---|---|
| signature, request created 3 April at any hour, 10-day period | calendar days from 3 April | signed 13 April: in time | signed 14 April: lapsed |
| spacing, previous extension effective 1 March, 180-day spacing | calendar days from 1 March | effective 28 August: qualifies | effective 27 August: does not |

**Measures.** Installments paid are the whole calendar months from the first payment date to the next due date, less the installments deferred by every extension; days past due are the calendar days from the next due date to the effective date when the next due date is earlier, and 0 otherwise.

superseded_clauses: One extension defers at most extension_max_months_per_request installments, the installments deferred in the rolling 12 months (contract_msr_extension_months_12m) including this one may not exceed extension_max_months_per_12_months, and over the contract's life (contract_msr_extension_months_life) including this one may not exceed extension_max_months_per_life.

The extension fee is extension_fee_usd of the tier and is assessed (fee_treatment fee_assessed) on the effective date, except that where the tier's extension_first_fee_waived is true and the contract has no earlier extension, the fee is waived (fee_treatment fee_waived).
